lines.text: God calls Ezekiel son of man and tells him to pack his bags for exile before a rebellious house.
Ezekiel digs through the wall by hand and carries his belongings out at dusk on his shoulder as they watch.
God says the prince in Jerusalem will be caught in His net and brought to Egypt, where he will die.
God tells Ezekiel to eat his bread with trembling and drink his water with quivering and anxiety.
God says the land of Israel will be stripped because of the sickness of all who dwell in it.
